sample_unit: AI-generated medical images identification attempts (16 images x 2 models)

links.outcome: Ability of AI models to identify their own generated medical images as AI-generated
links.effect: 27/32 incorrect vs 5/32 correct (84.37% vs 15.62%; p = 0.001); ChatGPT accuracy 18.75%, Gemini 12.5%; Gemini anatomy images 0% correct.
links.quote: There were significantly higher incorrect rates than correct identification rates for AI-generated images overall (27/32 incorrect vs. 5/32 correct; 84.37% vs. 15.62%; p = 0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates the capability of multimodal generative models (ChatGPT-4 and Google Gemini 1.5 Pro) to correctly identify medical images they generated themselves, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
